# loop variable after its loop.
# ZIP_LISTS: only the loop variable that takes the flags list holds them (_pcg_o and _pcg_z_1 do not),
# and every loop variable is restored when the loop ends (_pcg_a2); literal baseline levels.
# $ENV{} in a CMAKE_ variable that holds no compiler flags, and in a command that grants nothing.
